question: For every reachable nonterminal TRUMP state under the frozen macro grammar, is there a polynomially discoverable certified terminal/descent transition?
target_statement: FOR ALL reachable nonterminal F: EXISTS a transition M discoverable in polynomial time such that CERT(F->M(F))=PASS and either M(F) is a verified terminal or Phi(M(F))<Phi(F).

proof_route.A_state_normal_form: Define the exact reachable-state grammar after R33/RUP/BVE normalization; no appeal to finite samples.
proof_route.B_exhaustive_symbolic_case_partition: Partition every reachable nonterminal state by polynomially decidable structural predicates. Every case must be covered with no residual OTHER bucket unless explicitly OPEN.
proof_route.C_local_transition_theorem: For each case, construct a transition and prove equisatisfiability/reconstruction, strict progress or terminality, polynomial representation, and polynomial verification.
proof_route.D_discovery_theorem: Prove the case predicate and candidate construction can be found without exhaustive exponential search or hidden advice.
proof_route.E_global_height_bound: Prove an explicit polynomial bound on the number of accepted transitions from an n-bit input, including any formula-size growth.
proof_route.F_complexity_composition: Compose discovery, construction, certificate verification, update, and transition count into one explicit polynomial T(n).

counterexample_route.objective: If any theorem obligation fails, produce a concrete reachable state witnessing the failure instead of weakening the quantifier.

forbidden_shortcuts: heuristic or JANUS rank => proof authority
unbounded 2^k or factorial search hidden inside candidate discovery
strict descent without polynomial height bound
polynomial step cost measured only in current size while current size can blow up superpolynomially
oracle, advice, truth labels, SAT solver used as hidden selector

r46_dependency.R46A: performance only; may replace producer after semantic equivalence PASS
r46_dependency.R46B: may remove global argmin requirement if transition admissibility is purely local
r46_dependency.R46C: ranking only; exhaustive certified fallback mandatory
r46_dependency.R46D: incremental state only; must preserve exact semantics

pass_condition: A symbolic FOR-ALL proof satisfying all five obligations with explicit polynomial bounds and no unresolved residual case.
nonpass_condition: Any explicit counterexample, unbounded parameter, residual structural case, or missing polynomial bound leaves R47A FAIL/OPEN.
